svg.title: Five ways to set up the Meta Conversions API, by effort and control
svg.desc: Illustrative positioning chart. Meta's one-click Conversions API in Events Manager: lowest effort, least control. Platform partner integrations such as Shopify or WooCommerce plugins: low effort, low control. Conversions API Gateway: medium effort, low to medium control. Server-side Google Tag Manager: medium effort, high control, and it can feed other platforms too. Direct API integration: highest effort, full control.
svg.text: Which Conversions API setup fits you?
Every method ends at the same API. They differ in who runs the server and how much you control.
More
Less
Effort to set up and maintain
Less control
Full control
Control over events, parameters and destinations
Meta's one-click CAPI
set up in Events Manager; mirrors the Pixel
Platform / plugin integration
e.g. Shopify's Meta app, WooCommerce plugins
Conversions API Gateway
Meta software in your own AWS or GCP account
Server-side GTM
one event feeds Meta, GA4, TikTok, Google Ads
effort drops with managed hosting
Direct API
your developers own hashing, retries, tokens
Illustrative positioning based on how each method works, not measured data. Your effort depends on your platform and team.
Sources: Meta for Developers (Conversions API, Conversions API Gateway); platform documentation.
